title: Authorize loop truth reads by trading stage instead of comparing it to the deployment name

hosted_incident.identity: operator_a (claims: roles, tenant_id, allowed_tenants; no environment claim)
hosted_incident.before_behaviour: authenticated_loop_truth_scope set deployed_environment from PANTHEON_ENV ('dev') and, without an environment claim, enforced environment == deployed_environment ('paper' == 'dev'), returning 403 Forbidden with precondition_failed='environment_scope'.
hosted_incident.after_behaviour: authenticated_loop_truth_scope treats requested environment as correlation envelope trading stage ('paper', 'broker_sandbox', 'canary', 'live') and authorizes it against stages served by the deployment. A dev deployment serves ('paper', 'broker_sandbox'). The deployment name is used only to select the served set and is never compared to the trading stage directly. 'paper' is served on dev, allowing operator_a to read successfully without 403.

ac1_trading_stage_authorization.detail: authenticated_loop_truth_scope treats requested environment as correlation envelope trading stage ('paper', 'broker_sandbox', 'canary', 'live') and checks against served_stages. Dev deployment serves ('paper', 'broker_sandbox'). Deployed environment name is never compared directly to the stage. Requesting deployment name 'dev' as environment is rejected.

ac2_identity_allowed_environments.detail: Identities declaring allowed_environments retain their constraint: only declared stages or wildcard are permitted. When identity omits environment claim, all stages served by deployment are permitted.

ac3_default_stage_resolution.detail: When no stage is requested, read defaults to first stage served by the deployment (served_stages[0] == 'paper' on dev) instead of the deployment name.

ac4_non_dev_deployment_fails_closed.detail: Deployments other than dev serve only explicitly configured stages (via served_stages parameter or PANTHEON_LOOP_TRUTH_SERVED_STAGES) and otherwise have served_stages=(), failing closed with 403 environment_scope.

ac5_shared_caller_authorization.detail: All callers of authenticated_loop_truth_scope (loop_health near line 563, loop_health_detail near line 597, list_loop_runs near line 679, get_loop_run near line 761) share the same single stage authorization method with no per-route copy.

ac6_dev_login_operator_readback_test.detail: Verified in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_control_loops_router.py::test_dev_login_operator_reads_paper_loop_run_and_refuses_live: dev-login style operator reads tenant-dev paper loop run successfully with 200 and receives 403 environment_scope for environment=live.

ac7_hosted_403_and_before_after_evidence.detail: Documented in hosted_incident section of this manifest citing deploy run 37614660335, artifact loop-prod-tel-002-bff-readback-37614660335-1.json, and exact before/after reader behavior.

ac8_net_prod_line_budget_and_no_compress.detail: Net production line change is +26 lines (+2 in router.py, +24 in service.py), strictly within the 40 net line budget. Standard clean multiline formatting preserved with no compressed code.

ac9_hosted_track_external_wait.detail: Hosted track: the next automatic dev pair release passes the authenticated public BFF readback step of the canonical paper lifecycle probe or its evidence names the next failing gate; recorded as external_wait until then.
